module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeastTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowTargets (windowAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedTargets (combinedPrograms)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedWrapperTargets (thinMatchingWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedDirectedXTargets (directedX)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAuxTargets (thinPairedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edgeGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureMemoTargets (selectedMeasure)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets (measuredExchange)

/-- The common successful least over the MEASURED guarded paired exchange `Xm`
at the two auxiliary applications, from one accepted function-level edge of the
same `Xm` between `f` and `g`, the two held type guards and the argument window.
No least call, measure report, cover report, reverse edge, pool or length is an
input; the common least value `x` is handed to the continuation. -/
def ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeast : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s
      (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) (directedX base P.V)))
    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph Xm W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (x : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (a.relabel j) x)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (b.relabel j) x)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal)

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeastTargets

68	attribute [local irreducible] programGraph
69	variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)}
70	
71	private theorem edgeRename {α β : Type} (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b : OTerm α)
72	    (j : α → β) :
73	    (edgeGraph X W ctx ty a b).relabel j =
74	      edgeGraph X W (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) := by
75	  simp only [edgeGraph,programRename,edgeTape,quadInputsRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel]
76	
77	/-- The five non-measure parent reports, moved into a continuation context. -/
78	private structure Moved {α β : Type} (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (j : α → β)
79	    (TV G : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α) : Prop where
80	  syn : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
81	    (unary TV (suc z) (dom.relabel j) ⊓ unary TV (suc z) (cod.relabel j)))
82	  ty : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
83	    (unary G (suc z) (dom.relabel j) ⊓ unary G (suc z) (cod.relabel j)))
84	  argument : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
85	    (windowAt W (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))
86	  fg : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
87	    (edgeGraph D W (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j)))
88	  gf : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
89	    (edgeGraph D W (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (g.relabel j) (f.relabel j)))
90	
91	private theorem move {α β : Type} {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {Γ : List (Formula α)}
92	    (Δ : List (Formula β)) (j : α → β) (keep : ∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ)
93	    (TV G : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α)
94	    (syn : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)))
95	    (ty : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary G (suc z) dom ⊓ unary G (suc z) cod)))
96	    (argument : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)))
97	    (fg : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)))
98	    (gf : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f))) :
99	    Moved body Δ j TV G D W ctx dom cod f g arg := by
100	  have syn' := renameInto syn j Δ keep
101	  have ty' := renameInto ty j Δ keep
102	  have argument' := renameInto argument j Δ keep
103	  have fg' := renameInto fg j Δ keep
104	  have gf' := renameInto gf j Δ keep
105	  simp only [conjunctionRename,unaryRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at syn' ty'
106	  rw [windowRename] at argument'
107	  simp only [edgeRename,rawConsRename] at fg' gf'
108	  exact ⟨syn',ty',argument',fg',gf'⟩
109	
110	/-- Re-derived from the (private) helper of the PairedCommonLeast proof; it is
111	generic in the base exchange under the cover guard. -/
112	private theorem shareLeast {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}
113	    (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (baseX : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b x : OTerm α)
114	    (ab : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph (guardedExchange C s baseX) W ctx ty a b)))
115	    (ba : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph (guardedExchange C s baseX) W ctx ty b a)))
116	    (la : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty a x)))
117	    (hb : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (hasLeast C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty b))) :
118	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty b x)) := by
119	  let X := guardedExchange C s baseX
120	  apply casesLeast C X W s ctx ty b (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty b x) hb
121	  intro β i Θ y keep ly
122	  rw [leastRename]
123	  have ab' := renameInto ab i Θ keep
124	  have ba' := renameInto ba i Θ keep
125	  have la' := renameInto la i Θ keep
126	  rw [edgeRename] at ab' ba'
127	  rw [leastRename] at la'
128	  obtain ⟨ab'⟩ := ab'
129	  obtain ⟨ba'⟩ := ba'
130	  obtain ⟨la'⟩ := la'
131	  obtain ⟨ly⟩ := ly
132	  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_MutualEdgeMinimumEquality C s baseX W body β Θ
133	    (ctx.relabel i) (ty.relabel i) (a.relabel i) (b.relabel i) (x.relabel i) y
134	  have eq : Derivation body Θ (eqn (x.relabel i) y) :=
135	    Derivation.implicationElimination law (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction
136	      (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction la' ly) (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction ab' ba'))
137	  exact outputTransport (packedLeastProgram C X W s) (suc y) (suc (x.relabel i))
138	    ![ctx.relabel i,ty.relabel i,b.relabel i] ⟨congSuc (symm eq)⟩ ⟨ly⟩
139	
140	/-- The common least over the measured exchange from the two directed function
141	edges and a common selected measure of the two functions (measured analogue of
142	`ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureCommonLeast`). -/
143	theorem measuredCommonLeastOfFunctionMeasure
144	    (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
145	    {α : Type} (Γ : List (Formula α)) (ctx dom cod f g arg m : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α) :
146	    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
147	    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
148	    let D := directedX base P.V
149	    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
150	    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
151	    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
152	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
153	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
154	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
155	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
156	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f)) →
157	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m f)) →
158	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m g)) →
159	    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (x : OTerm β),
160	      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
161	      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
162	        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (a.relabel j) x)) →
163	      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
164	        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (b.relabel j) x)) →
165	      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
166	    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal) := by
167	  intro P W D Xm a b syn ty argument fg gf cf cg k
168	  have ab := measuredEdgeOfFunctionMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Γ
169	    ctx dom cod f g arg m syn ty argument fg gf cf cg
170	  have ba := measuredEdgeOfFunctionMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Γ
171	    ctx dom cod g f arg m syn ty argument gf fg cg cf
172	  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge Xm W body α Γ ctx cod a b
173	  obtain ⟨abd⟩ := ab
174	  have windows := Derivation.conjunctionRight
175	    (Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft law) abd)
176	  obtain ⟨repA⟩ := exact_OpenCoverThinMatchingWindowReport P.cover P.W P.V Xm s body α Γ ctx cod a
177	    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft windows⟩
178	  obtain ⟨repB⟩ := exact_OpenCoverThinMatchingWindowReport P.cover P.W P.V Xm s body α Γ ctx cod b
179	    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight windows⟩
180	  apply casesLeast P.cover Xm W s ctx cod a goal ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight repA⟩
181	  intro β j Δ x keep la
182	  have hb := renameInto ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight repB⟩ j Δ keep
183	  rw [hasRename] at hb
184	  have ab' := renameInto ⟨abd⟩ j Δ keep
185	  have ba' := renameInto ba j Δ keep
186	  rw [edgeRename] at ab' ba'
187	  have lb := shareLeast P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D)) W
188	    (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) x ab' ba' la hb
189	  exact k β j Δ x keep la lb
190	
191	theorem exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeast :
192	    ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeast := by
193	  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f g arg goal P W Xm a b syn ty argument fgm k
194	  let N := selectedMeasure P.R
195	  let D := directedX base P.V
196	  have edges := pairedParentEdges P.cover s (measuredExchange N D) W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g fgm
197	  have uf := measuredParentEdge N D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g edges.1
198	  have ug := measuredParentEdge N D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f edges.2
199	  apply compareCases N f g goal uf.2
200	  intro β j Δ m keep mf mg
201	  have mv := move Δ j keep TV _ D W ctx dom cod f g arg syn ty argument uf.1 ug.1
202	  apply measuredCommonLeastOfFunctionMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Δ
203	    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) m
204	    (goal.relabel j) mv.syn mv.ty mv.argument mv.fg mv.gf mf mg
205	  intro γ i Θ x retain la lb

207	    rw [← formulaRelabelComposition j i q]
208	    exact retain (q.relabel j) (keep q hq)
209	  rw [formulaRelabelComposition j i goal]
210	  rw [← auxiliaryTermRename] at la
211	  rw [← auxiliaryTermRename] at lb
212	  simp only [Term.relabel_relabel] at la lb
213	  exact k γ (i ∘ j) Θ x both la lb

public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeastProof
open FirstOrder Language

open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus ID1Completion.InternalControlGraph

  (measuredParentEdge measuredEdgeOfFunctionMeasure)

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph
variable {body : Positive (Fin 1)}

private theorem edgeRename {α β : Type} (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b : OTerm α)
    (j : α → β) :
    (edgeGraph X W ctx ty a b).relabel j =
      edgeGraph X W (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j) (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) := by
  simp only [edgeGraph,programRename,edgeTape,quadInputsRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel]

/-- The five non-measure parent reports, moved into a continuation context. -/
private structure Moved {α β : Type} (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (j : α → β)
    (TV G : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α) : Prop where
  syn : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (unary TV (suc z) (dom.relabel j) ⊓ unary TV (suc z) (cod.relabel j)))
  ty : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (unary G (suc z) (dom.relabel j) ⊓ unary G (suc z) (cod.relabel j)))
  argument : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (windowAt W (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (arg.relabel j)))
  fg : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (edgeGraph D W (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j)))
  gf : Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
    (edgeGraph D W (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (g.relabel j) (f.relabel j)))

private theorem move {α β : Type} {body : Positive (Fin 1)} {Γ : List (Formula α)}
    (Δ : List (Formula β)) (j : α → β) (keep : ∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ)
    (TV G : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx dom cod f g arg : OTerm α)
    (syn : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)))
    (ty : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary G (suc z) dom ⊓ unary G (suc z) cod)))
    (argument : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)))
    (fg : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)))
    (gf : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f))) :
    Moved body Δ j TV G D W ctx dom cod f g arg := by
  have syn' := renameInto syn j Δ keep
  have ty' := renameInto ty j Δ keep
  have argument' := renameInto argument j Δ keep
  have fg' := renameInto fg j Δ keep
  have gf' := renameInto gf j Δ keep
  simp only [conjunctionRename,unaryRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at syn' ty'
  rw [windowRename] at argument'
  simp only [edgeRename,rawConsRename] at fg' gf'
  exact ⟨syn',ty',argument',fg',gf'⟩

/-- Re-derived from the (private) helper of the PairedCommonLeast proof; it is
generic in the base exchange under the cover guard. -/
private theorem shareLeast {α : Type} {Γ : List (Formula α)}
    (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (baseX : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (ctx ty a b x : OTerm α)
    (ab : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph (guardedExchange C s baseX) W ctx ty a b)))
    (ba : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph (guardedExchange C s baseX) W ctx ty b a)))
    (la : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty a x)))
    (hb : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (hasLeast C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty b))) :
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph C (guardedExchange C s baseX) W s ctx ty b x)) := by
  let X := guardedExchange C s baseX
  apply casesLeast C X W s ctx ty b (leastGraph C X W s ctx ty b x) hb
  intro β i Θ y keep ly
  rw [leastRename]
  have ab' := renameInto ab i Θ keep
  have ba' := renameInto ba i Θ keep
  have la' := renameInto la i Θ keep
  rw [edgeRename] at ab' ba'
  rw [leastRename] at la'
  obtain ⟨ab'⟩ := ab'
  obtain ⟨ba'⟩ := ba'
  obtain ⟨la'⟩ := la'
  obtain ⟨ly⟩ := ly
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_MutualEdgeMinimumEquality C s baseX W body β Θ
    (ctx.relabel i) (ty.relabel i) (a.relabel i) (b.relabel i) (x.relabel i) y
  have eq : Derivation body Θ (eqn (x.relabel i) y) :=
    Derivation.implicationElimination law (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction
      (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction la' ly) (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction ab' ba'))
  exact outputTransport (packedLeastProgram C X W s) (suc y) (suc (x.relabel i))
    ![ctx.relabel i,ty.relabel i,b.relabel i] ⟨congSuc (symm eq)⟩ ⟨ly⟩

/-- The common least over the measured exchange from the two directed function
edges and a common selected measure of the two functions (measured analogue of
`ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureCommonLeast`). -/
theorem measuredCommonLeastOfFunctionMeasure
    (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    {α : Type} (Γ : List (Formula α)) (ctx dom cod f g arg m : OTerm α) (goal : Formula α) :
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
    let a := auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg
    let b := auxiliaryTerm dom cod g arg
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (edgeGraph D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) m g)) →
    (∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (x : OTerm β),
      (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (a.relabel j) x)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ
        (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (b.relabel j) x)) →
      Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (goal.relabel j))) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ goal) := by
  intro P W D Xm a b syn ty argument fg gf cf cg k
  have ab := measuredEdgeOfFunctionMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Γ
    ctx dom cod f g arg m syn ty argument fg gf cf cg
  have ba := measuredEdgeOfFunctionMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Γ
    ctx dom cod g f arg m syn ty argument gf fg cg cf
  obtain ⟨law⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge Xm W body α Γ ctx cod a b
  obtain ⟨abd⟩ := ab
  have windows := Derivation.conjunctionRight
    (Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft law) abd)
  obtain ⟨repA⟩ := exact_OpenCoverThinMatchingWindowReport P.cover P.W P.V Xm s body α Γ ctx cod a
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft windows⟩
  obtain ⟨repB⟩ := exact_OpenCoverThinMatchingWindowReport P.cover P.W P.V Xm s body α Γ ctx cod b
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight windows⟩
  apply casesLeast P.cover Xm W s ctx cod a goal ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight repA⟩
  intro β j Δ x keep la
  have hb := renameInto ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight repB⟩ j Δ keep
  rw [hasRename] at hb
  have ab' := renameInto ⟨abd⟩ j Δ keep
  have ba' := renameInto ba j Δ keep
  rw [edgeRename] at ab' ba'
  have lb := shareLeast P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D)) W
    (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (a.relabel j) (b.relabel j) x ab' ba' la hb
  exact k β j Δ x keep la lb

theorem exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeast :
    ExactOpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeast := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f g arg goal P W Xm a b syn ty argument fgm k
  let N := selectedMeasure P.R
  let D := directedX base P.V
  have edges := pairedParentEdges P.cover s (measuredExchange N D) W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g fgm
  have uf := measuredParentEdge N D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) f g edges.1
  have ug := measuredParentEdge N D W ctx (rawCons dom cod) g f edges.2
  apply compareCases N f g goal uf.2
  intro β j Δ m keep mf mg
  have mv := move Δ j keep TV _ D W ctx dom cod f g arg syn ty argument uf.1 ug.1
  apply measuredCommonLeastOfFunctionMeasure (body := body) V TV M M0 B T base s Δ
    (ctx.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (f.relabel j) (g.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) m
    (goal.relabel j) mv.syn mv.ty mv.argument mv.fg mv.gf mf mg
  intro γ i Θ x retain la lb
  have both (q : Formula α) (hq : q ∈ Γ) : q.relabel (i ∘ j) ∈ Θ := by
    rw [← formulaRelabelComposition j i q]
    exact retain (q.relabel j) (keep q hq)
  rw [formulaRelabelComposition j i goal]
  rw [← auxiliaryTermRename] at la
  rw [← auxiliaryTermRename] at lb
  simp only [Term.relabel_relabel] at la lb
  exact k γ (i ∘ j) Θ x both la lb

#print axioms measuredCommonLeastOfFunctionMeasure
#print axioms exact_OpenCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeast
end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredPairedCommonLeastProof

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedSharedMeasureTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets
public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedSeenDefinitions

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets (roundGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets (memberGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseDirectedSeen (acceptEdge)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)

/-- The application motive at a function-level round member `k`: `k` has the
fixed selected measure `μ` under `N`, and the application of `k` to the fixed
`arg` (annotations `dom`, `cod`) has the successful packed least `m` of the
application-level programs `C X W s` at `ctx`, `ty`. -/
def appMotive {α : Type} (N : Program 1) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3)
    (s : Settings) (ctx ty dom cod arg μ m k : OTerm α) : Formula α :=
  unary N μ k ⊓ leastGraph C X W s ctx ty (auxiliaryTerm dom cod k arg) m

/-- One-edge premise in the style of `SameLeastOnEdge`, at every body, context
and term: an accepted function-level edge `w → k` of the edge program `E` at
`fctx`, `fty` carries the application motive from `w` to `k`. -/
def ApplicationEdgeStep (E : Program 4) (N : Program 1) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2)
    (W : Program 3) (s : Settings) : Prop :=
  ∀ (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (fctx fty ctx ty dom cod arg μ m w k : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ ((acceptEdge E fctx fty w k ⊓
      appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m w).imp (appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m k)))

/-- The same premise relative to one context `Γ` and fixed parameters: it is
asked only in contexts that extend `Γ` along a renaming, so facts held in `Γ`
(type guards, argument window) may be used to pay it. -/
def ApplicationEdgeStepAt (E : Program 4) (N : Program 1) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2)
    (W : Program 3) (s : Settings) (body : Positive (Fin 1)) {α : Type} (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (fctx fty ctx ty dom cod arg μ m : OTerm α) : Prop :=
  ∀ (β : Type) (j : α → β) (Δ : List (Formula β)) (w k : OTerm β),
    (∀ p ∈ Γ, p.relabel j ∈ Δ) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (acceptEdge E (fctx.relabel j) (fty.relabel j) w k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (appMotive N C X W s (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j)
      (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) (μ.relabel j) (m.relabel j) w)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Δ (appMotive N C X W s (ctx.relabel j) (ty.relabel j)
      (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) (μ.relabel j) (m.relabel j) k))

/-- Round induction with the application motive, relative premise: every member
`k` of an actual finite round (any count `i`) of the members computation for `E`
from `seed` satisfies the motive, given the motive at the seed. -/
def ExactRoundApplicationLeastAt : Prop :=
  ∀ (E : Program 4) (N : Program 1) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (i vertices fctx fty seed out k ctx ty dom cod arg μ m : OTerm α),
    ApplicationEdgeStepAt E N C X W s body Γ fctx fty ctx ty dom cod arg μ m →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m seed)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (roundGraph E out i vertices fctx fty seed)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph out k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m k))

/-- The same in the formula style of #835 `ExactRoundLeast`, under the global
one-edge premise. -/
def ExactRoundApplicationLeast : Prop :=

        (appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m k)))

/-- Generic: the function's own successful packed least `x` (function-level
programs `Cf Xf Wf sf`, the least whose members are computed with
`edge4 Xf Wf`) satisfies the application motive of the seed `f`, under the
relative one-edge premise for that same edge program. -/
def ExactLeastRepresentativeApplication : Prop :=
  ∀ (Cf : Program 3) (Xf : Program 2) (Wf : Program 3) (sf : Settings)
    (N : Program 1) (C : Program 3) (X : Program 2) (W : Program 3) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (fctx fty f x ctx ty dom cod arg μ m : OTerm α),
    ApplicationEdgeStepAt (edge4 Xf Wf) N C X W s body Γ fctx fty ctx ty dom cod arg μ m →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph Cf Xf Wf sf fctx fty f x)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (appMotive N C X W s ctx ty dom cod arg μ m x))

/-- An accepted edge of the guarded paired exchange over `measuredExchange M D`
is an accepted edge of the guarded paired exchange over `D` (same cover,
settings and window). -/
def ExactMeasuredToPlainEdge : Prop :=
  ∀ (C : Program 3) (s : Settings) (M : Program 1) (D : Program 2) (W : Program 3)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α)) (ctx ty w k : OTerm α),
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ
      (acceptEdge (edge4 (guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange M D))) W) ctx ty w k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (acceptEdge (edge4 (guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange D)) W) ctx ty w k))

/-- Edge premise discharged with no remaining premise when the function-level
round uses the measured exchange `Xm` and the application least uses the
chosen unmeasured exchange `X` (same cover and window). -/
def ExactMeasuredCombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod arg μ m : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let X := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange D)
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    ApplicationEdgeStepAt (edge4 Xm W) (selectedMeasure P.R) P.cover X W s body Γ
      ctx (rawCons dom cod) ctx cod dom cod arg μ m

/-- Round theorem for the measured function-level exchange, no measure premise. -/
def ExactMeasuredCombinedRoundApplicationLeast : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod f arg μ m i vertices out k : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let X := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange D)
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) μ f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) m)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (roundGraph (edge4 Xm W) out i vertices ctx (rawCons dom cod) f)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (memberGraph out k)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) μ k ⊓
      leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod k arg) m))

/-- Application to a fixed argument factors through the function's least
representative (unmeasured chosen exchange), under the measure-preservation
premise. The seed's measure is not an input; the seed application's least `m`
is. -/
def ExactCombinedLeastRepresentativeApplication : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod f x arg m : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let X := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (directedX base P.V))
    MeasurePreservingEdge (edge4 X W) (selectedMeasure P.R) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) m)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx (rawCons dom cod) f x)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod x arg) m))

/-- The same with the function's least taken for the measured exchange `Xm`;
no measure premise remains. -/
def ExactMeasuredCombinedLeastRepresentativeApplication : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod f x arg m : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let X := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange D)
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod f arg) m)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover Xm W s ctx (rawCons dom cod) f x)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (leastGraph P.cover X W s ctx cod (auxiliaryTerm dom cod x arg) m))

end LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationRepresentativeTargets

attribute [local irreducible] programGraph

theorem exact_MeasuredToPlainEdge : ExactMeasuredToPlainEdge := by
  intro C s M D W body α Γ ctx ty w k e
  let Dm := measuredExchange M D
  let Xm := guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange Dm)
  let X := guardedExchange C s (thinPairedExchange D)
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := e
  obtain ⟨lawM⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge Xm W body α Γ ctx ty w k
  have calls := Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionLeft lawM) e
  have windows := Derivation.conjunctionRight calls
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := conjunctionRecover (thinPairedExchange Dm) (compareOptions C s) (exchangeTape w k)
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft calls⟩
  obtain ⟨pp⟩ := conjunctionRecover Dm (thinSwapExchange Dm) (exchangeTape w k) ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft g⟩
  obtain ⟨fwdM⟩ := conjunctionRecover D (compareMeasurements M) (exchangeTape w k) ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft pp⟩
  have revDm : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph Dm (suc z) (exchangeTape k w))) := by
    apply compositionRecover Dm ![.projection 1,.projection 0] (suc z) (exchangeTape w k) ![k,w]
      ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight pp⟩
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun t => ?_) i
    · exact projectionValue 1 (exchangeTape w k)
    · obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero t
      exact projectionValue 0 (exchangeTape w k)
  obtain ⟨revM⟩ := conjunctionRecover D (compareMeasurements M) (exchangeTape k w) revDm
  have swap : Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (programGraph (thinSwapExchange D) (suc z) (exchangeTape w k))) := by
    apply compositionValue D ![.projection 1,.projection 0] (suc z) (exchangeTape w k) ![k,w]
      ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft revM⟩
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun t => ?_) i
    · exact projectionValue 1 (exchangeTape w k)
    · obtain rfl := Fin.eq_zero t
      exact projectionValue 0 (exchangeTape w k)
  have paired := conjunctionAccept D (thinSwapExchange D) (exchangeTape w k)
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionLeft fwdM⟩ swap
  obtain ⟨guarded⟩ := conjunctionAccept (thinPairedExchange D) (compareOptions C s) (exchangeTape w k)
    paired ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight g⟩
  obtain ⟨lawX⟩ := exact_OpenPackedScalarEdge X W body α Γ ctx ty w k
  exact ⟨Derivation.implicationElimination (Derivation.conjunctionRight lawX)
    (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction guarded windows)⟩

theorem exact_MeasuredCombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt : ExactMeasuredCombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod arg μ m P W D X Xm syn ty argument
  intro β j Δ w k keep e mw
  have syn' := renameInto syn j Δ keep
  have ty' := renameInto ty j Δ keep
  have argument' := renameInto argument j Δ keep
  simp only [conjunctionRename,unaryRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at syn' ty'
  rw [windowRename] at argument'
  rw [rawConsRename] at e
  obtain ⟨mwd⟩ := mw
  have mwm : Derivation body Δ (unary (selectedMeasure P.R) (μ.relabel j) w) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionLeft mwd
  have mwl : Derivation body Δ (leastGraph P.cover X W s (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)
      (auxiliaryTerm (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) w (arg.relabel j)) (m.relabel j)) :=
    Derivation.conjunctionRight mwd
  have plain := exact_MeasuredToPlainEdge P.cover s (selectedMeasure P.R) D W body β Δ (ctx.relabel j)
    (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) w k e
  obtain ⟨ed⟩ := e
  obtain ⟨pres⟩ := exact_MeasuredExchangePreservesMeasure P.cover s (selectedMeasure P.R) D W body β Δ
    (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (μ.relabel j) w k
  have mk := Derivation.implicationElimination pres (Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction ed mwm)
  obtain ⟨lk⟩ := exact_CombinedApplicationLeastStep V TV M M0 B T base s body β Δ (ctx.relabel j)
    (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) (μ.relabel j) (m.relabel j) w k syn' ty' argument'
    plain ⟨mwm⟩ ⟨mk⟩ ⟨mwl⟩
  exact ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction mk lk⟩

theorem exact_MeasuredCombinedRoundApplicationLeast : ExactMeasuredCombinedRoundApplicationLeast := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f arg μ m i vertices out k P W D X Xm syn ty argument
    mf lf round member
  have step := exact_MeasuredCombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod arg μ m
    syn ty argument
  obtain ⟨mf⟩ := mf
  obtain ⟨lf⟩ := lf
  exact exact_RoundApplicationLeastAt (edge4 Xm W) (selectedMeasure P.R) P.cover X W s body α Γ
    i vertices ctx (rawCons dom cod) f out k ctx cod dom cod arg μ m step
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction mf lf⟩ round member

theorem exact_CombinedLeastRepresentativeApplication : ExactCombinedLeastRepresentativeApplication := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f x arg m P W X meas syn ty argument lf lx
  apply programCases (selectedMeasure P.R) ![f] _
  intro β j Δ μ keep mf
  rw [inputsRename] at mf
  rw [leastRename,appAuxRename]
  have syn' := renameInto syn j Δ keep
  have ty' := renameInto ty j Δ keep
  have argument' := renameInto argument j Δ keep
  simp only [conjunctionRename,unaryRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at syn' ty'
  rw [windowRename] at argument'
  have lf' := renameInto lf j Δ keep
  rw [leastRename,appAuxRename] at lf'
  have lx' := renameInto lx j Δ keep
  rw [leastRename,rawConsRename] at lx'
  have step := exact_CombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt V TV M M0 B T base s body β Δ (ctx.relabel j)
    (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) μ (m.relabel j) meas syn' ty' argument'
  obtain ⟨mf⟩ := mf
  obtain ⟨lf'⟩ := lf'
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := exact_LeastRepresentativeApplication P.cover X W s (selectedMeasure P.R) P.cover X W s
    body β Δ (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (f.relabel j) (x.relabel j)
    (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) μ (m.relabel j) step
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction mf lf'⟩ lx'
  exact ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight d⟩

theorem exact_MeasuredCombinedLeastRepresentativeApplication :
    ExactMeasuredCombinedLeastRepresentativeApplication := by
  intro V TV M M0 B T base s body α Γ ctx dom cod f x arg m P W D X Xm syn ty argument lf lx
  apply programCases (selectedMeasure P.R) ![f] _
  intro β j Δ μ keep mf
  rw [inputsRename] at mf
  rw [leastRename,appAuxRename]
  have syn' := renameInto syn j Δ keep
  have ty' := renameInto ty j Δ keep
  have argument' := renameInto argument j Δ keep
  simp only [conjunctionRename,unaryRename,sucRelabel,zRelabel] at syn' ty'
  rw [windowRename] at argument'
  have lf' := renameInto lf j Δ keep
  rw [leastRename,appAuxRename] at lf'
  have lx' := renameInto lx j Δ keep
  rw [leastRename,rawConsRename] at lx'
  have step := exact_MeasuredCombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt V TV M M0 B T base s body β Δ (ctx.relabel j)
    (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) μ (m.relabel j) syn' ty' argument'
  obtain ⟨mf⟩ := mf
  obtain ⟨lf'⟩ := lf'
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := exact_LeastRepresentativeApplication P.cover Xm W s (selectedMeasure P.R) P.cover X W s
    body β Δ (ctx.relabel j) (rawCons (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j)) (f.relabel j) (x.relabel j)
    (ctx.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (dom.relabel j) (cod.relabel j) (arg.relabel j) μ (m.relabel j) step
    ⟨Derivation.conjunctionIntroduction mf lf'⟩ lx'
  exact ⟨Derivation.conjunctionRight d⟩

#print axioms exact_MeasuredCombinedLeastRepresentativeApplication

module

public import LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationRepresentativeTargets

@[expose] public section
namespace LogicLineages.PersistentMarking.NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedMeasuredRoundTargets
open FirstOrder Language
open LogicLineages.OrdinalComparison.TerminationOrdering
open PositiveArithmeticOperators ID1Completion.InternalCalculus
open ID1Completion.InternalGraphComposition (OTerm)
open ID1Completion.InternalTagArithmeticSyntaxProof (suc z)
open LogicLineages.ComputabilityKnowledge.GorbowPRProgram
open NumberedWindowScalarAlgorithm (Settings)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePathEnvelopeTargets (unary rawCons)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePassWindowTargets (windowAt)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseRawFunctionFrameTargets (auxiliaryTerm)
open NumberedWindowInternalSettingsGrammarGuardDefinitions (refitGuard)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedTargets (combinedPrograms)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedWrapperTargets (thinMatchingWindow)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedDirectedXTargets (directedX)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedPairedAuxTargets (thinPairedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseCoverGuardedExchangeTargets (guardedExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScalarEdge (edge4)
open NumberedWindowInternalAuxMeasureMemoTargets (selectedMeasure)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparsePackedLeastOpen (leastGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseOpenRoundsTargets (roundGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalSparseScratchMembershipTargets (memberGraph)
open NumberedWindowInternalMeasuredAuxExchangeTargets (measuredExchange)
open NumberedWindowInternalCoverCombinedRestrictedRoundApplicationTargets

/-- Edge premise discharged with no remaining premise when BOTH the
function-level round and the application-level least use the one measured
exchange `Xm` (same cover and window). Layout of
`ExactMeasuredCombinedApplicationEdgeStepAt`, with the application exchange
`X` replaced by `Xm`. -/
def ExactFullyMeasuredApplicationEdgeStepAt : Prop :=
  ∀ (V TV M M0 : Program 1) (B : Program 2) (T : Program 1) (base : Program 2) (s : Settings)
    (body : Positive (Fin 1)) (α : Type) (Γ : List (Formula α))
    (ctx dom cod arg μ m : OTerm α),
    let P := combinedPrograms s V TV M M0 B T
    let W := thinMatchingWindow P.cover s P.W P.V
    let D := directedX base P.V
    let Xm := guardedExchange P.cover s (thinPairedExchange (measuredExchange (selectedMeasure P.R) D))
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary TV (suc z) dom ⊓ unary TV (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) dom ⊓ unary (refitGuard s T) (suc z) cod)) →
    Nonempty (Derivation body Γ (windowAt W ctx dom arg)) →
    ApplicationEdgeStepAt (edge4 Xm W) (selectedMeasure P.R) P.cover Xm W s body Γ
      ctx (rawCons dom cod) ctx cod dom cod arg μ m

/-- Round theorem with one exchange system throughout: the round is computed
with `edge4 Xm W` and the application least is the least of `Xm`. No measure

## Note for Opus B (join regression)

In these modules the join is `ActualSignedRouteCartesian.tuplePacket` over `choices`, and projection
is applied only afterwards, to `prepend top (tuplePacket …)` inside `lowerFamily`. The regression
"two rows force the greatest coordinate to be `C` and `C+1`" should be stated on the joined packet
(`PacketHolds f baseline top z (tuplePacket [p₁,p₂])` false for every `z`, hence
`LowerHolds … (project C (tuplePacket [p₁,p₂]))` false), since each row's own projected packet is
